programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.desc: Could a ballad made famous by late, lamented folk singer Johnny Carver be an inspiration for murder? Did someone want to kill Toby Winning for threatening to take the Little Crosby Folk Festival away from Midsomer - or is the true motive something hidden for 20 years?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The fizz goes out of a sparkling wine launch when the glasses are laced with slug poison. Who is targeting the Midsomer Vinae Winery and what does the attack have to do with the death of a child in a hit-and-run accident?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: New DCI John Barnaby arrives in Midsomer and is bemused by the quaint villages and their quirky residents. But when a local DJ is crushed to death at a traditional girls' boarding school, he soon discovers that murder and deception are never far away. As the death toll rises, could Barnaby's first case also be his last?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The reclusive lives of elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham (Edward Fox and Phyllida Law) comes under police scrutiny when a social services investigator (Jeff Rawle) is murdered. Barnaby and Jones must unearth generations of family secrets and decipher astronomical charts to find the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a young woman is dressed like a bride and drowned in a bath, it triggers a spate of ghoulish wedding-themed murders in Great Worthy. The case takes Barnaby and Jones to a donkey sanctuary, a heritage steam railway and a pub run by an ex-copper and former brothel madam. With the serial killer still at large, could history be repeating itself?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Jones goes undercover at the Oblong Foundation after one of the cult's young female members disappears suddenly. But he and Barnaby soon start digging into an old case involving the death of a couple in a boat explosion.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In Midsomer Mow, the gruesome discovery of a farmer's eviscerated body in an ancient stone circle is made just days before the spring equinox.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A VAT inspector goes missing as he hunts for an illicit cider still responsible for brewing The Beast, a potent local hooch. At the Midsomer Abbas spring fayre which celebrates its friendship with Midsomer Herne, Barnaby and Jones sample the local cider, while temperance preacher Norman Grigor calls on residents to repent of their drunken ways. Suddenly, Barnaby is violently ill as the body of missing man Peter Slim is found floating in the cider vat. Meanwhile Samuel Quested (Warren Clarke), the traditionalist mayor of Midsomer Abbas, seeks to revive the ancient rite known as 'The Stag'.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones investigate the cloistered world of Midsomer Priory when a nun is strangled to death. The detectives uncover a complex mystery involving holy orders, teenage romantic liaisons, African art and missing antique silver as the community is forced to open its doors to 21st-century policing.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A row between keen birdwatchers in Midsomer-in-the-Marsh turns nasty when their president is killed. Patrick Morgan met his death while hoping to sight a rare bird, but is his obsession with ornithology to blame - or something more sinister?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When MATTHEW DRAPER, a quarry worker is killed by a demolition charge after obeying the orders of his foreman, IAN FRASER, to return to the unexploded device, no one can predict how it might effect the tranquil village of Fletcher's Cross nine years later...

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby's aunt, Alice Bly (Phyllis Calvert), has an addiction to detective stories, a deep admiration for her favourite nephew, and is recovering from an operation at the Lawnside Nursing Home. When a resident dies, Alice Bly picks up gossip which, mixed with the detective fiction with which she is passing the hours, makes her think that all is not as it should be at Lawnside.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village of Midsomer Mallow is one of the villages hoping to win the title of the "Perfect English Village" competition. As the story unfolds, not everything is "perfect" as local thief Peter Drinkwater is stabbed with a pitchfork at an abandoned farm, he's using as a squat. Shortly after robbing a retired actor's home. Despite the villagers' best efforts to keep the murder quiet so as to not ruin their chances in the competition, several further deaths occur eventually bringing Detective Chief Inspector Barnaby back several decades to uncover the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Whilst the Upper Marshwood hunt assemble outside the village inn, a filthy tramp-like man leaves the shop and skulks into the wood. Soon after, he hears the sound of the hunt begin and the unforgettable noise of the horses and hounds in hot pursuit of the fox. Running for cover, towards the safety of his home-made shelter, he stumbles and falls into a pit - screaming. LIZA, isolated in the disused railway carriage which constitutes her home, moves deeper into the wood having heard the scream. She finds the pit and sees the tramp lying crumpled on the ground, clearly dead. She stares at him for a moment, then turns and walks away.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A disused airfield near Morton Fendle is the location for a romantic evening between young Simon Bright and his girlfriend Laura Sharp - absolutely nothing could ruin their date. The next morning, when Frances Kirby is out for her morning jog, she notices the vintage car they were in up at the airfield, containing Simon Bright's dead body, with Laura nowhere to be seen. Confused, Detective Chief Inspector Barnaby and D.S. Jones can't work out whether it was a suicide pact or murder. Furthermore, they've got to find Miss Sharp and their investigation leads them to linking Simon and Laura with the villagers of Morton Fendle, who met at Elaine Trim's dancing classes. Eventually, the Barnaby family plus Jones make it to a 40s style dance night at the village hall before more villagers start turning up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer County to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters, she gets a shock - Rex's staff had been told that she was dead. Things become even more complex when Rex's body is found in a nearby river, bearing wounds that suggest he was murdered. Barnaby and Jones are soon on the case, trying to establish who would have wanted the elderly man dead. Several people soon come forward with multiple wills, which confuse the matter, but when two more people, close friends of Rex, are also murdered, the investigation raises question on the motive, leading Barnaby to wonder if it was down to finances, passion, or something from Rex's past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Following the death of Alan King while on a business trip to China, the family company, King's Crystal, is in financial trouble. As plans to shut the Midsomer Magna factory are being put into action, Alan's wife Hilary and brother Charles are married in the village church - much to the dismay of Alan's son Ian. In addition to strife between members of the family, the factory workers are outraged at the loss of their jobs. So when company accountant Peter Baxter is found murdered, Barnaby and Jones suspect a disgruntled employee is to blame. But in order to investigate the matter further, Jones is forced to work undercover, and infiltrate the local group of Freemasons in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The music lovers of Midsomer County are delighted when a host of bands arrives for the Midsomer Rocks festival. Barnaby himself is particularly looking forward to seeing recently re-formed rock band, Hired Gun, perform on stage, but he soon gets close to the band for rather unfortunate reasons. During their opening performance, the band's singer, Mimi (Suzi Quatro), falls to the ground dead - electrocuted by a wire that had been run through the microphone stand. Barnaby and Jones soon find the rest of the band could be targets, and when another is killed, questions are raised as to whether former band member, Ginger Foxton, who went missing for 30 years and is presumed dead, is still at large. The detectives soon have to delve into a world of rock music, drug use and greed, to find the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The suspicious death of popular young GP Dr Alan Delaney brings Barnaby and Jones to Midsomer Market to investigate. The detectives are baffled as to a motive for murder - until they consider that the newly engaged Dr James Kirkwood may have been the intended victim. Before long, Barnaby and Jones are heading to Wales - former home to Delyth Mostyn, James's fiancee, to delve deeper into the mystery. There are certainly possible suspects in the murder and attempt on Kirkwood, from Delyth's children, who oppose the engagement, Delyth's husband, and more, as the detectives investigate things, in hopes of uncovering the truth before a major walk is to take place on Mount Snowdon.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the build-up to Luxton Deeping's annual photographic exhibition, a battle rages between the traditional and digital photographers of the pretty village. The dispute seems harmless enough - until Lionel Bell is found murdered in a nearby woodland, strangled with the cord of his light meter. Barnaby soon gets to work tracking down the killer, but it seems someone is trying to implicate the detective in the murder. And once he is replaced on the case, finding the culprit seems less likely than ever, as his replacement is more concerned of an upcoming wedding than the investigation. Barnaby is forced to work off the case to uncover who is framing him, and who wants dead other photographers in the village.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance.After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.desc: Nothing But A Winner chronicles the rise of the University of Alabama's legendary football dynasty, shaped by Coaches Bear Bryant and Nick Saban. Through first-hand accounts from barrier-breaking players spanning five decades, the film explores the culture of relentless commitment that turns raw recruits into national champions. programme.title: Bone Hampton
programme.desc: As down home as collards and cornbread, as sharp as a pickaxe, and as funny as a possum in a petticoat, Comedian Bone Hampton is a master at making audiences feel like family. His clean, homespun humor, sharp wit, and easy delivery makes the Dove Award-winning "Comedian of the Year" one of the most highly sought after performers in the business. With more than 20 years in the game, his résumé is ever expanding with impressive stage and TV credits. The Texas native has logged countless appearances on ABC's "The View," including two stints as Guest Co-Host, and has served as personal gag writer for Actress/Comedienne Sherri Shepherd since 2010. He's also appeared on ABC's "Less Than Perfect," NBC's "My Name is Earl," BET's "Comic View," and the syndicated talk show Comics Unleashed with host Byron Allen. And yes, that is Bone in the very funny national commercial for Church's Chicken. No stranger to the big screen, Bone has appeared alongside Hollywood juggernaut Sandra Bullock in the romantic comedy "All About Steve," and can be seen in the film "Woodlawn" starring Sean Austin and Oscar winner Jon Voight. Bone took a leap of faith and moved to Los Angeles to pursue comedy full-time. Nothing could have prepared him for the culture shock that greeted him. Next to the hardcore acts he shared the stage with, his family-friendly routine seemed soft. But that fish-out-of-water experience inspired him to remain true to himself and to his God—no matter where he performed. He set out to carve out a niche all his own. (And carve he did!) In 2005, the Urban Gospel Alliance named him “Comedian of the Year.” His mission was simple—“I just like to have a good time. I just want to be the ringleader of the good time,” Bone says. Ask anyone who's ever seen Bone Hampton perform, they will tell you: Mission accomplished. Bone can be heard all day long on satellite radio, and caught on TV anytime your television is on.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: Los corrompidos
programme.desc: En un gran hotel hay de todo, una telefonista ninfómana, un recepcionista jugador y un elevadorista inescrupuloso.

programme.title: Romance en Puerto Rico
programme.desc: Una joven escapa como polizón en un barco que viaja a Puerto Rico para no casarse con un millonario.

programme.title: Santa Claus
programme.desc: Santa y el mago Merlín se unen para frustrar los planes del diablo de extender la tentación entre los niños del mundo.

programme.title: Hoy He Soñado con Dios
programme.desc: Una mujer tiene tres hijos muy diferentes: una hija fracasada, el otro un boxeador furtivo y su hijo el sacerdote.

programme.title: El fin de un imperio
programme.desc: El teniente del batallón de Rurales, José Antonio Navarrete, es considerado héroe y enemigo de los imperialistas, quienes raptan a su gran amor para atraerlo e imponerle sus condiciones políticas.

programme.title: El hijo del palenque
programme.desc: Un gallero es asesinado en su palenque, y su esposa muere al dar a luz. Un amigo de ellos lleva al niño con su abuela.

programme.title: El pistolero del Diablo
programme.desc: Un hombre mata a su hijo, se vuelve alcohólico, pierde a su mujer, tiene alucinaciones y un pacto con el diablo.

programme.title: Las Pobres Ilegales
programme.desc: Una joven huye de su casa por su padrastro y se va a los EE.UU., donde descubre el abuso a los indocumentados.

programme.title: Veneno para las Hadas
programme.desc: Un par de amigas de 10 años, deciden preparar un veneno para las hadas, ya que una de ella se siente bruja.

programme.title: Cinco Nacos Asaltan Las Vegas
programme.desc: Un burócrata desempleado y cuatro amigos viajan a Las Vegas para asaltar un casino.

programme.title: Jóvenes Delincuentes
programme.desc: Jóvenes se encuentran atrapados en un mundo de drogas y crímenes del que es casi imposible escapar.

programme.title: Sábado Violento
programme.desc: Dos hermanos periodistas compiten entre sí por obtener los mejores reportajes, hasta el punto de arriesgar la vida.

programme.title: La historia de un gángster
programme.desc: La historia de un delincuente que sale de prisión antes de tiempo por buena conducta, pero este vuelve a meterse en problemas y retoma la vida criminal.

programme.title: La piel de la muerte
programme.desc: Dos mujeres huérfanas protegen un tesoro escondido al que todo el mundo anda buscando en el desierto.

programme.title: Pilotos de Combate
programme.desc: Unos pilotos de la fuerza aérea investigan en una misión antidrogas y descubren a un mafioso que disfraza sus negocios.

programme.title: S.O.S. Conspiración Bikini
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de mujeres hermosas, una organización internacional de terroristas crean problemas en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: Me llaman violencia
programme.desc: Una mujer logra escapar de los asesinos de su padre, mientras huye conoce a un hombre que le ofrece protección.

programme.title: Kapax del Amazonas
programme.desc: Una antropóloga norteamericana viaja en un avión con su esposo, periodista y aviador. Se accidentan y caen en la mitad de la selva, él es devorado por las alimañas mientras Linda es rescatada por un aborigen.

programme.title: Matar por matar
programme.desc: La posesión de un revólver determina la vida y la muerte de quienes lo empuñan en un determinado momento.

programme.title: Elena y Raquel
programme.desc: Una joven está embarazada de un novio que la abandonó y odia al bebé, pero al nacer cambian sus sentimientos hacia el menor.

programme.title: El señor gobernador
programme.desc: Un humilde peón llega a ser gobernador y ayuda a los pobres, pero sus métodos son criticados y quieren derrocarlo.

programme.title: Tuya Para Siempre
programme.desc: La modelo de un pintor es seducida por un hombre que se va a Europa y ella se casa, pero enviuda y se hacen amantes.

programme.title: Casa de vecindad
programme.desc: En una vecindad varias personas tienen relaciones extramaritales y se desencadenan chismes entre todas las familias.

programme.title: La familia y uno más
programme.desc: Un padre de familia con 16 hijos hace frente a los conflictos, alegrías y los infortunios de una gran familia.

programme.title: Contra viento y marea
programme.desc: Dos hermanos regresan de estudiar química en Europa, desprecian a su enriquecido padre y no lo ayudan en su empresa.

programme.title: La Morena de mi Copla
programme.desc: Un pintor ayuda a una joven gitana y la lleva a vivir a su casa, pero un amigo torero de este se enamora de ella.

programme.title: El rebozo de Soledad
programme.desc: Una humilde pueblerina mancillada muere durante el nacimiento de su bebé y luego su esposo es asesinado.

programme.title: Bartolo toca la flauta
programme.desc: Un joven distraído es apresado con falsos cargos porque al cacique de la región le gusta su novia.

programme.title: Se la llevó el Remington
programme.desc: En la feria del pueblo, una adivina predice a una bella joven que el matón contratado por el cacique la seducirá.

programme.title: Yo fui una usurpadora
programme.desc: La amante de un médico le va a dar el hijo anhelado, él se divorcia de su esposa, pero ella le oculta su reciente embarazo.

programme.title: Traigo mi 45
programme.desc: La novia de Francisco Reynoso busca la fama en la gran ciudad. Se adentra en un mundo peligroso, se junta con un grupo de delincuentes y encuentra un final trágico cuando su búsqueda de la fortuna la lleva a cometer un asesinato.

programme.title: Nosotras las sirvientas
programme.desc: Un joven atropella a una campesina recién llegada a la ciudad. Lleno de culpa, busca recompensarla al ofrecerle un trabajo como sirvienta.

programme.title: Sábado Negro
programme.desc: Un hombre casado busca pasar una divertida noche de soltero y por su infidelidad se enfrenta a la peor pesadilla de su vida.

programme.title: Usted tiene ojos de mujer fatal
programme.desc: Un mujeriego finalmente se enamora de una dama que lo hace sufrir y que luego de un tiempo lo acepta.

programme.title: Bala de Plata en el pueblo maldito
programme.desc: Un joven es herido y pierde su caballo, cuando sana reclama una mina hallada por su padre y recupera a su animal.

programme.title: El Herrero
programme.desc: La ex novia de un duque se casa por despecho con un herrero enriquecido, pero un duelo la hace demostrar su amor.

programme.title: El Misterio del Rostro Pálido
programme.desc: Un médico investiga una grave enfermedad y utiliza a pacientes misteriosamente conseguidos que poco a poco han ido muriendo.

programme.title: Tlayucán
programme.desc: Por una situación límite, un hombre se convierte en ladrón. Si su identidad se conoce, sus vecinos podrían lincharlo. La única persona amable de la ciudad es el sacerdote local.

programme.title: El hacha diabólica
programme.desc: El Santo es perseguido por el encapuchado del hacha sin saber que se trata de una venganza que tiene siglos de historia.

programme.title: Las recién casadas
programme.desc: Tres recién casadas de distinto nivel social tienen serios problemas en su matrimonio.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe
programme.desc: Malta's Mdina through the history of the Knights of Malta, who ruled the island for nearly 300 years; the great palaces of the nobility and their Gothic and classical architecture; the city's medieval atmosphere in the winding Moorish streets.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe
programme.sub-title: Mdina and Rabat - In the Steps of St. Paul
programme.desc: The Roman history of Malta and St. Paul's internment on the island; in Rabat, experiencing key sites such as the splendid Roman villa, the Grotto of St. Paul and the catacombs where Christians seek refuge; the events of the Great Siege of 1565.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul
programme.sub-title: Touring the Cradle of Western Civilization
programme.desc: The dynamic civilizations that emerge in the Aegean; the scope of the human drama that is played out there; some of the towering figures and remarkable sites to encounter; Professor Hale's recommendations for traveling this world as the ancients did.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul
programme.sub-title: Athens - Around the Acropolis and Parthenon
programme.desc: The Acropolis is a symbol of Athens; the path of the ancient annual procession honoring Athena; the history and meanings of the site's iconic buildings; the superlative architectural features of the Parthenon and its surprising original uses.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul
programme.sub-title: In the Footsteps of Socrates - Historic Athens
programme.desc: Treasures surrounding the Acropolis; the Theater of Dionysos, where one ponders the rituals of early dramatic festivals; the Odeon of Herodes Atticus, a venue of music and recitations; the Pnyx, an ancient hilltop assembly point; the agora market.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul
programme.desc: Visiting sacred monuments of Greece's beautiful Attica region; the Amphiareion is a shrine of a prophet deity; ancient oracle and healing practices; imposing shrines to Artemis and Poseidon; Eleusis is the site of mystical religious rituals.

programme.title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages
programme.desc: Contemplating the French art de vivre and the appeal that makes France one of the most visited tourist spots; an overview of the upcoming journey across the rich cultural landscape of France; learning about the iconic figure of Charles de Gaulle.

programme.title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages
programme.sub-title: The Birth and Rise of Paris
programme.desc: Learning how Paris evolves from an ancient settlement to a Roman city and then the capital; studying medieval Paris through the Cluny Museum, the great cathedral of Notre Dame and the royal chapel of Sainte-Chapelle; following the growth of Paris.

programme.title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages
programme.desc: Discovering the Palace of Versailles as the world of Louis XIV; noting how the landscaping surrounding the palace symbolizes features of Louis's reign and how the Versailles court prizes royal spectacle; exploring Louis's patronage of the arts.

programme.title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages
programme.desc: Examining the social and political background of the French Revolution of 1789; visiting key locations in Paris where the events unfold, from a coffee house to the site of the Bastille prison and the Place de la Concorde; mapping Napoleon's rise.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C.
programme.sub-title: How Washington DC Came to Be
programme.desc: Uncovering the origins of the District of Columbia; how the location for the national government is chosen; the original design and vision for the city by artist and engineer Pierre Charles L'Enfant; the creation and history of the National Mall.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C.
programme.sub-title: The White House and the Presidency
programme.desc: Tracking the history and fortunes of the White House; visiting the White House, beginning with the Oval Office and Cabinet Room; visiting the parks adjoining the White House; the Jefferson and Franklin Delano Roosevelt memorials.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C.
programme.sub-title: The Capitol Building and the Legislature
programme.desc: How the Capitol building is designed, constructed and expanded in the early years of the nation; touring the architectural and artistic wonders of the building; concluding with the House and Senate Chambers; the surrounding parks and gardens.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C.
programme.sub-title: The Supreme Court and the Law of the Land
programme.desc: Studying the founding and history of the Supreme Court; touring this structure, its interior features, court facilities and artistic decoration; exploring the Court in action, which encompasses courtroom procedure and how cases are processed.

programme.title: Cooking Across the Ages
programme.desc: What one can learn about different cultural groups through the lens of their cookbooks; looking at two chicken recipes 200 years and a continent apart; learning to cook dishes from a 1748 French cookbook and "The Can-Opener Cookbook" of 1953.

programme.title: Cooking Across the Ages
programme.desc: Whether the recipes in "De re coquinaria" are bizarre and disgusting, or they reflect a time of elegance and luxury; exploring its sala cattabia, minutal of apricots and botellum; finding three delicious, and even somewhat familiar, dishes.

programme.title: Cooking Across the Ages
programme.desc: Examining the Chinese Wei dynasty's "Qi Min Yao Shu"; learning about Chinese agricultural practices going back to antiquity; the fermentation practices of the time; following a scaled-down recipe to create a fermented black bean dish.

programme.title: Cooking Across the Ages
programme.sub-title: Medieval Egypt: Chickpeas and Phyllo Dough
programme.desc: Exploring recipes from 14th-century Egypt that reflect the interchange between the many cultures of the Eastern Mediterranean of the time; learning to make himmas kassa and a light and flaky phyllo dough stretched to the size of a table.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: What archeologists actually do; the nature and scope of their work; misconceptions about the field; tracing the history of archeology, from its beginnings with the ancient Babylonian king Nabonidus to archeological luminaries of the 20th century.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: Traveling to the sites of Pompeii and Herculaneum, which are destroyed by the 79 A.D. eruption of Mount Vesuvius; the history of their excavation; the preservation of buildings, objects and human remains; discovering details of ancient Roman life.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.sub-title: Schliemann and His Successors at Troy
programme.desc: Following the exploits of Heinrich Schliemann as he looks for Homer's Troy; learning about his dig through nine stratified cities; the finds; the debates over which city is Troy; tracing subsequent work at the site; examining the conclusions.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: The history of finds in Mesopotamia; the 19th-century unearthing of the Assyrian palaces at Nimrud and Nineveh, with their libraries of cuneiform texts; contemplating the 20th-century discovery of the treasures of the "Death Pits of Ur".

programme.title: Notorious London: A City Tour
programme.desc: London when it is home to Oscar Wilde at the close of the 19th century; the details of Wilde's trial for indecency; the way London society is structured; how immense wealth and privilege, for some, leaves its imprint on the city and its history.

programme.title: Notorious London: A City Tour
programme.sub-title: St. Paul's Cathedral in Faith, Fire, and Sin
programme.desc: St. Paul's Cathedral has overlooked London from a high point in the city for generations; the history of this church that has been much more than a place of worship; it has survived fire and the ravages of war; episodes from the cathedral's past.

programme.title: Notorious London: A City Tour
programme.sub-title: Getting Blitzed at London's Café de Paris
programme.desc: An evening in March 1941, when the Café de Paris is destroyed in the Blitz; the history of the café; how its destruction reflects the horrors of wartime London; the resiliency of the citizens who keep calm and carry on under the threat of war.

programme.title: Notorious London: A City Tour
programme.sub-title: On Carnaby Street during the Swinging '60s
programme.desc: Carnaby Street emerges in the 17th century; a symbol of social change in the 1960s; its history; it becomes a magnet for trendsetters and youth culture in post-war London; why these changes are embraced by some and seen as a threat by others.

programme.sub-title: The World of Vincent Van Gogh
programme.desc: Facts about Van Gogh's life.

programme.sub-title: Baudelaire and the Definition of Modernism
programme.desc: A poet and art critic named Charles Baudelaire begins writing systematically about art in 1846; his basic idea is that art should be "of its own times"; he struggles to find artists who will embody his ideals.

programme.title: From Monet to Van Gogh: A History of Impressionism
